summary: Add a gated Topnet live adapter to the existing Companion Payment Core.
reason: The agreed Topnet journey requires the first native owner biometric to trigger one deterministic background payment attempt, keeping the same payment request through any issuer-required challenge and provider reconciliation.

tests.name: typescript-build
tests.evidence: Companion TypeScript build passed after adding the adapter and bounded 225 second execution window.

tests.name: topnet-live-adapter
tests.evidence: 4/4 adapter tests passed: gate-off default, exact quote and single dispatch, unmatched settlement fail-closed, verified rejection mapping.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability truth remains in samantha-ui-playbooks; this repository implements the gated runtime contract.

architecture.reason: Reuses the existing Payment Core, Companion process, Billing runner and native owner confirmation. No new daemon, scheduler, database or execution owner.

rollback: Remove the private acceptance marker, restore the prior Companion runtime and preserve all payment guard records. Never replay an engaged payment.
limitations: Topnet live execution is disabled unless the exact private acceptance marker exists.
bank challenge authentication is not automated or exposed to the model.
An interrupted live attempt remains effect_unknown and is never replayed automatically.
